text:
Andrew Birkle and Shawn Windsor are LIVE on the Freep Sports Show discussing the #detroitlions vs. #minnesotavikings NFC North game in Week 8 at Ford Field. Did the Lions finally take hold of the division? Was Jared Goff able to pick apart Brian Flores' blitz-heavy defense? And how did the Lions' secondary hold up against Kyler Murray and the Kevin O'Connell attack?
All that and more with Shawn and Andrew.
